queries.query: Identifying the operating conditions that control PFAS foam fractionation. Prepare a focused review of how PFAS properties, water chemistry, and reactor operation control foam-fractionation performance.
Evaluate effects of PFAS chain length and functional group, co-surfactants, organic matter, salts, and competing constituents.
Compare gas flow, bubble size, residence time, recycle, foam collection, and reactor configuration.
Interpret removal, recovery, enrichment, mass balance, and volume reduction as distinct performance measures.
